# Goldsmiths Research Online

> An institutional research repository providing open access to scholarly outputs, theses, and publications from Goldsmiths, University of London.

Goldsmiths Research Online (GRO) is the official digital repository for research outputs from Goldsmiths, University of London. It supports open access compliance with funder mandates including Plan S, UKRI, and the Research Excellence Framework (REF2029), while providing browsable archives organized by publication year, item type, and funded projects.

## Discovery & Browsing

- [Advanced Search](https://research.gold.ac.uk/cgi/tabbed_search/advanced): Advanced search interface with filters for academic database discovery
- [Browse by Year](https://research.gold.ac.uk/view/year): Chronological browsing interface for research outputs by publication year
- [Browse by Item Type](https://research.gold.ac.uk/view/type): Browse repository content by item type classification and metadata taxonomy
- [Browse by Publication](https://research.gold.ac.uk/view/publication): Alphabetical index of scholarly works and conference proceedings
- [Browse by Project or Series](https://research.gold.ac.uk/view/by_projects): Directory of funded research projects from AHRC, GCRF, British Academy

## Theses & Collections

- [Theses Archive](https://research.gold.ac.uk/view/theses/archive.html): Browsable archive of postgraduate theses and dissertations from Goldsmiths

## Open Access & Compliance

- [Open Access at Goldsmiths](https://research.gold.ac.uk/openaccess.html): Researcher guide to open access, Plan S, and REF2029 compliance
- [Funder Open Access Policies](https://research.gold.ac.uk/funder-oa-policies.html): Guidance on UKRI, REF, and Horizon 2020 open access requirements

## Repository Information

- [Homepage](https://research.gold.ac.uk): Homepage for Goldsmiths Research Online institutional repository
- [About](https://research.gold.ac.uk/information.html): About page describing GRO repository overview and deposit guidelines
- [Help](https://research.gold.ac.uk/help): User guide for browsing, searching, and viewing research outputs in GRO

## Support & Accessibility

- [Accessibility](https://research.gold.ac.uk/accessibility): WCAG compliance and accessibility statement for screen readers and navigation

## Optional

- [Policies](https://research.gold.ac.uk/policies.html): Repository policies including copyright, takedown, and content guidelines
- [Repository Statistics](https://research.gold.ac.uk/cgi/stats/report): Usage analytics and download tracking for repository research metrics
